basic_info.description: The extraordinary panoramic views will take your breath away in this spacious condominium in a classic San Francisco Edwardian.  The bright open living and dining space is highlighted by an expansive bay window so the views of the Bay Bridge, Coit Tower and the Transamerica pyramid are never missed.  Gorgeous details include refinished hardwood floors, coved ceilings, elegant moldings throughout and a handsome marble fireplace in the living room with a gas insert. Enjoy the modern beautifully refined kitchen and bathroom plus in unit laundry and plenty of storage space. The roomy primary bedroom features a decorative fireplace, mirrored closets and a sunny bay window nook too. Russian Hill offers both gourmet dining and casual cafes plus amazing views as you experience the neighborhood and hear the occasional trill of cable car bells or the local parrots.
